blocks.text: Setting up Zoom for teachers on Mac

Before your first class, ensure your Mac is ready. Zoom requires specific permissions to function correctly. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone and verify that Zoom is toggled on. Do the same for your Camera. If your screen share is black, check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording and grant access to Zoom.
If you are unsure where a setting is, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur. Lazur will draw a circle around the exact menu item you need.
blocks.title: Find controls faster

blocks.text: Essential keyboard shortcuts for your virtual classroom

Using the mouse during a lesson can distract students. Rely on keyboard shortcuts to stay in control. Use ⌘ ⇧ M to toggle your microphone and ⌘ ⇧ V to toggle your video. Use ⌘ ⇧ S to start screen sharing. If you want to see the chat, press ⌘ ⇧ H.
Managing student engagement and classroom flow

A common mistake is leaving the waiting room disabled. Always enable the waiting room to control who enters your class. Go to the security icon in the meeting toolbar to toggle this. If you need to share audio from a video, remember to check the Share Sound box in the screen sharing window.

Teachers report that administrative tasks consume a large portion of their day. You can use your Mac to automate mundane parts of your workflow. Instead of manually typing repetitive feedback, use a text expander or dictate your notes. If you are struggling with email volume, use voice dictation to draft responses quickly.

Audio issues are the most frequent complaint. If students cannot hear you, check your audio input settings. Go to Zoom Settings > Audio and verify the correct microphone is selected. If you have multiple devices, your Mac might be defaulting to the wrong one. You can test your speaker and microphone directly from this menu.
How to stay focused while teaching

Distractions are everywhere. Use Focus modes on your Mac to silence notifications while you are in a meeting. You can also use apps like Opal to block non-essential websites during your teaching hours. Keeping your digital workspace clean helps you focus on what matters: your students.

Preparation is key. Schedule your recurring meetings in advance to save time. Use the Zoom desktop app to copy the invite link and share it with your students via your learning management system. If you need to record a session, start it early and check your storage location in Settings > Recording.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to click buttons in Zoom?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons for you. It points at the screen to show you where to click, or explains how to perform a task.

faq.question: Why is my screen share black in Zoom?
faq.answer: This is usually a permission issue. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording and ensure Zoom is enabled.

faq.question: How do I make my cursor more visible to students?
faq.answer: You can enlarge your cursor in System Settings > Accessibility > Display. You can also use Lazur to guide you through the exact settings.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my meeting audio?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not store your audio. It only processes what you say while you hold the shortcut key.
